component.name: Rock n' Roll Racing (Static Recomp)
component.summary: SNES static recompilation for Linux (SDL3). ROM required.

description.p: Native Linux port of the Rock n' Roll Racing (SNES, 1993) static recompilation: ahead-of-time W65C816/SPC700 execution with an SDL3 frontend. The original game ROM is required and is never distributed with this package.
